reason: Version 3 keeps nearly every fact and nuance. Version 4 drops some details ("Those visits helped us get here," "anniversary to celebrate," "every book"). Version 2 adds invented claims ("started with what we loved," "first week," "reread a dozen times," "never gave it back"), while Version 1 cuts the choices/earn-its-place content and adds or distorts facts ("a little over 400," "bursting at the seams," "day one," garbled post 5).
